blocker.why: The producer chain ran correctly and fully - ingest -> build-snapshot -> build-analytics -> compile-candidates all succeeded on a real corpus - but the corpus holds ONE record derived from a real SDK FindingBundle that contains ZERO findings, so the compiler produced no promotion-eligible candidate and the publication gate refused to assemble a pack.
blocker.assessment: This is correct fail-closed behaviour by Intelligence, NOT a defect. The seam is unproven for lack of corpus data, not because the path is broken. Feeding the LSP a hand-authored pack would violate the Layer 2 producer rule, so it was not done.

producer_chain_proven.note: real SDK bundle into the corpus

consumer_not_exercised: l9-debt-lsp-contracts exposes evaluate-compatibility / install-pack / activate-pack / verify-installed-pack, but none was run: there is no real Intelligence-produced pack to feed them.
